end.parentNote: Nisha practised identifying equal shares and naming halves, thirds, and quarters. Asha used shaded-shape and fair-sharing examples; Nisha first mixed up the denominator and the parts left, then correctly explained that equal-sized parts are needed and selected the correct one-third and one-quarter examples. At home, use paper or fruit divided into equal pieces and ask, “How many equal parts make the whole, and how many are shaded?”
